sentences.en: Juha sat on a branch in a tree.
He cut the branch with a saw.
He sat on the far side.
He cut between the tree and himself.
A man passed on the road and saw him.
Juha did not listen to him at all.
After a minute the branch broke.
He got up and ran after the man.
He said: you knew that I would fall.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אז אתה יודע דברים.
sentences.en: He said: so you know things.
He asked: when shall I die?
The man ran away and did not answer him.
